milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate close to the brick_stairs (placed at spawn-relative [7, 0, 7]) and face toward them, modeling 'the player can see the brick_stairs'. max_distance=5 ensures the player is close enough to clearly identify the block, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking at it.
